# pve_node_subscription (Data Source)

Reads the subscription info of a node as reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/subscription`. Fields the API omits (e.g. on an unregistered node) are null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_node_subscription" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "subscription_status" {
  value = data.pve_node_subscription.pve1.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose subscription info is read.

### Read-Only

- `check_time` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last subscription check.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source (the node name).
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The subscription key, if set and permitted to access.
- `level` (String) A short code for the subscription level, e.g. `c` for community.
- `message` (String) A more human-readable status message.
- `next_due_date` (String) Next due date of the set subscription, e.g. `2027-01-01`.
- `product_name` (String) Human-readable product name of the set subscription.
- `reg_date` (String) Registration date of the set subscription.
- `server_id` (String) The server ID, if permitted to access.
- `signature` (String) Signature for offline keys.
- `sockets` (Number) The number of CPU sockets covered on this host.
- `status` (String) The current subscription status. Must be one of: `new`, `notfound`, `active`, `invalid`, `expired`, `suspended`.
- `url` (String) URL to the web shop.
